text:
Ava (PM): quick thread to nail down the prewarm credits / SLA fine print for reserved pools before next week's roadmap review. two decisions we need: billing model (bundled vs add-on) and launch eligibility/notice windows.

Raj (ProdEng): my vote = add-on with a bundled discount for >= 6mo commitments. keeps base reserved capacity predictable while still letting teams buy warm-up guarantees. also we need to decide how credits map to actual prewarm hosts.

Emily (SRE): technical note — prewarm uses pinned warm instances and interacts with autoscaler. if we count prewarm hosts as part of reserved capacity, it reduces headroom for live traffic. suggestion: treat prewarm as a separate accounting bucket with an eviction policy.

Theo (CS): customers asking for an actual latency SLA for cold-starts. they want guarantees like "startup within Xs for 99th pct". do we commit to a number or provide an SLA for the prewarm add-on only?

Ava (PM): proposal: prewarm add-on gives a 99th%-ile start <= 300ms for models under 1B params, and a separate tier for larger models. eligibility: customer must have >= reserved pool tier 2 and sign up min 3-month prewarm commitment. notice window: 7 days to provision. thoughts?

Sam (Sales): 7 days sounds okay but customers will push for carryover of unused prewarm credits month->month. we should clarify carryover policy. also need clear language for refunds if prewarm capacity unavailable due to region constraints.

Raj (ProdEng): +1 on separate accounting. operationally we can implement soft preemption: prewarm hosts get lowest eviction priority and are drained before reserved traffic is touched. fallback path: if prewarm capacity exhausted, route to on-demand cold path and log a SLA breach event for billing adjustments.

Emily (SRE): small config draft (pseudo YAML):
```
prewarm:
  tiers: [small, medium, large]
  commitment_months: 3
  notice_window_days: 7
  eviction_policy: soft_preempt
  carryover: none # or: carryover: up_to_25pct
```
We should include a metric tag for any SLA breach so billing can auto-issue credits.

Ava (PM): decision items for roadmap review: (1) bill as add-on with optional discounted bundle, (2) 3mo min commitment, 7d notice, (3) 99p<=300ms for <1B models, tiered for bigger models, (4) no automatic carryover by default (consider 25% promo carryover), (5) fallback to on-demand with automatic crediting when SLA violated.

Theo (CS): can we draft customer-facing wording? I can sketch the FAQ and legal-friendly bullet points. @Sam will you gather top-5 customer asks on carryover this week?

Sam (Sales): yep i'll pull CRM tickets and come back by thursday.

DeployBot: prewarm feature flag enabled in staging (prewarm-v2). build 2026.03.18-472 deployed to staging.

Raj (ProdEng): next engineering step: simulate eviction/fallback in our load test env and measure 99p. tagging this for next sprint spike.

Ava (PM): thanks everyone — i'll put these decision notes into the roadmap doc and include the SLA language draft. action owners: @Raj run load sims, @Emily add SLA breach metric, @Sam collate customer asks, @Theo draft FAQ. follow-up standup friday. :white_check_mark:
